notes: REF-BM-02: no metadata fetching on save; title falls back to url, no description/favicon/preview collection. REF-BM-03: title/description are manually editable before (form) and after (edit modal) save, but nothing is auto-collected. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable via PUT, but no note field exists. REF-BM-06: POST always items.push with no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-07: list shows title/url/description/tags but no favicon. REF-BM-10: tags entered via plain text input, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/url/description/tags but there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: '#tag' is treated as a literal substring, no tag-search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, unread view, or mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is sorted only by createdAt desc with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag, archive/delete distinction, or archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundles (saved filters). REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
